|===

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.
* `webcrypto`: The Web Cryptography API (W3C Recommendation, 2017) states no constant-time property of digest, sign or deriveBits; each JavaScript runtime's implementation decides, and webcpp reads none.

The default of `digests::md5`, `digests::sha1`, `digests::sha2_224`, `digests::sha2_256`, `digests::sha2_384`, `digests::sha2_512`, `digests::sha2_512_224` and `digests::sha2_512_256`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links (<<hash-default-backend>>).

`webcrypto` serves the asynchronous family alone, on Emscripten, where the type of its asynchronous call names it (<<hash-async-webcrypto>>).
